entities.summary: Trangan is an island in the Aru Islands in the Arafura Sea. It is situated in the Maluku Province of Indonesia. Its area is 2149 km2. The other main islands in the archipelago are Tanahbesar, Kola, Kobroor, Koba, and Maikoor.
